body.message:
Thank you for your message.

While we aim to respond promptly, response times may be slightly longer than usual due to the current situation in the UAE. We appreciate your patience and understanding.

Our working hours are between 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM UAE Time, Monday – Thursday and Friday 10:00 AM - 1:00 PM UAE Time.

We’ll get back to you as soon as possible. Thank you.
